defects.title: Since you were away says 'caught up' in a browser that has not shown the workspace before, although a task finished while the person was away
defects.repro:
Start `PORT=

DATA_DIR= PROVIDER_TOKEN=sk-local-abcdefghijkl node server.js`. In browser A open GET /, click Continue as Maya, send `research: Away test [long]`, close browser A. Wait until the task completes (8 steps x STANDIN_STEP_MS). Open a different browser or a private window, GET /, click Continue as Maya and read the region named Since you were away.
defects.observed: It reads 'You’re caught up on background work.' while the Tasks region shows 'Away test' Completed; the same browser profile A would have listed it as Completed. The last-seen time is kept in the browser's localStorage, not with the person.
defects.expected: On return, Since you were away lists the task that finished while the person was away (or at least does not claim there is nothing new).
